review_findings: PolicyCapability exposed executable state and authoritative digests instead of acting as an opaque authority handle.
Runtime validation did not bind all dynamically reachable helper and module-global policy dependencies.
Result publication used a check-then-write operation that could overwrite a concurrent result.
The declared negative-control cell was not executed by the confirmatory runner.
durable_execution_receipt_boundary: Task 7 still owns append-only external execution receipts and durable cross-process verification.
